independentExecution.scope: Original Library routing, URI parsing, collection client and protobuf serialization execute independently. The page's React action bar and original native HTTP WRITE producer do not execute here. Native write source and prior live checks remain scoped in native-now-playing-artist.json.

behavior: The artist route and visible About card use one shared membership owner and reusable button.
Visible controls publish optimistic membership together and stay enabled during a write. Your Library refreshes after a successful acknowledgement; rapid reversals share one serialized write lane.
Rejected writes restore the last acknowledged membership and show one retry snackbar for the write batch. Failed initial membership reads offer Retry.
A late membership read cannot overwrite pending membership or a newer settled change. Settled membership caching is bounded to 16 artists, with active writes protected from eviction.
Reads and caller waits retain caller cancellation. Account-owned writes survive removal of the initiating view; session reset cancels them and disposes the shared notifier.
The existing native artist snapshot and write path are reused. No new HTTP contracts, polling, overview requests or playback work are introduced by follow controls.

live.method: After each acknowledged write, invalidate the native artist snapshot and read fresh server membership. Restore initial membership in finally, close the runtime and remove temporary session files.
